guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：Prelude FLNG 海上處理工程
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Prelude FLNG offshore processing engineering
guides.concept: 以海上氣體處理、液化及儲運邊界解析Prelude FLNG 海上處理工程：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore Prelude FLNG offshore processing engineering through offshore gas treatment, liquefaction and storage/transfer boundaries: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「Prelude FLNG 海上處理工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識天然氣資源與庫存。油氣儲層需區分孔隙流體、壓力與連通；累計產量與可採資源不同。 建立儲層模型與物料平衡的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是海上氣體處理、液化及儲運邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。按給定假想數據覈對流入、流出與庫存。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Prelude FLNG 海上處理工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識海底與上部containment。多個屏障路徑與監測共同支持完整性；概念課不提供鑽井或井控操作參數。 建立井筒屏障與完整性的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是海上氣體處理、液化及儲運邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用原創功能圖區分承壓路徑與監測，不設計現場操作。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Prelude FLNG 海上處理工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識氣體與液化相態。氣液相分佈影響流動及設備負載；單相近似只適合指定假設。 建立多相輸送與壓降的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是海上氣體處理、液化及儲運邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想單相與兩相情境的模型失配。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Prelude FLNG 海上處理工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識浮式平臺與transfer。立管、海底設備與上部處理各有壓力、運動及可維修邊界。 建立海底連接與平臺的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是海上氣體處理、液化及儲運邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫平臺—海底接口並標海況及維護假設。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Prelude FLNG 海上處理工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識冷卻能耗與邊界。分離、壓縮與冷卻消耗能量；岸電改變部分排放邊界而不使全生命週期零排放。 建立處理能量與排放的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是海上氣體處理、液化及儲運邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開現場、外購電與生命週期假想排放。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Prelude FLNG 海上處理工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識可用率與事件證據。可用率受維護、完整性與供能限制；只做公開報告和假想事件分析。 建立監測停機與復原的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是海上氣體處理、液化及儲運邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在離線事件表比較停機、恢復及泄漏證據鏈。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify gas resources/inventory in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Prelude FLNG offshore processing engineering. Reservoirs distinguish pore fluids, pressure and connectivity; cumulative production differs from recoverable resources. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reservoir models and material balance, focusing on offshore gas treatment, liquefaction and storage/transfer boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check inflow, outflow and inventory using assumed data. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify subsea/topside containment in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Prelude FLNG offshore processing engineering. Multiple barriers/monitoring support integrity; conceptual courses supply no drilling or well-control settings. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of well barriers and integrity, focusing on offshore gas treatment, liquefaction and storage/transfer boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate containment and monitoring in an original functional diagram without field operations. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify gas/liquefaction phases in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Prelude FLNG offshore processing engineering. Gas/liquid distributions affect flow/loading; single-phase approximations need bounded assumptions. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of multiphase transport and pressure drop, focusing on offshore gas treatment, liquefaction and storage/transfer boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare single/two-phase assumed cases for model mismatch. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify floating-platform transfer in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Prelude FLNG offshore processing engineering. Risers, subsea systems and topsides have distinct pressure, motion and serviceability boundaries. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of subsea links and platforms, focusing on offshore gas treatment, liquefaction and storage/transfer boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw platform/subsea interfaces with environmental/service assumptions. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify cooling energy/boundaries in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Prelude FLNG offshore processing engineering. Separation, compression and cooling use energy; shore power shifts some emissions without making lifecycle emissions zero. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of processing energy and emissions, focusing on offshore gas treatment, liquefaction and storage/transfer boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate onsite, purchased-power and lifecycle assumed emissions. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify availability/event evidence in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Prelude FLNG offshore processing engineering. Maintenance, integrity and energy affect availability; analyze public reports/assumed events only. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of monitoring, shutdown and recovery, focusing on offshore gas treatment, liquefaction and storage/transfer boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare downtime, recovery and containment evidence in an offline event table. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交冷卻能耗與邊界的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交可用率與事件證據的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交可用率與事件證據的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for cooling energy/boundaries.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for availability/event evidence.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for availability/event evidence.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：恢復產量本身就證明所有安全狀態均正確。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Recovered production proves every safety state correct.

practice: 對照天然氣資源與庫存與Troll油氣與壓力，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。

practiceEn: Compare gas resources/inventory with troll oil/gas pressure and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Troll offshore oil/gas platforms, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from availability/event evidence and propose an observation distinguishing offshore gas treatment, liquefaction and storage/transfer boundaries from gravity bases, shore power and compression support, including uncertainty.
